training.name: Hero training
training.summary: 20% less Gold for weekly hero training; XP and the once-per-hero-per-week limit stay unchanged.

trade.name: Market purchases
trade.summary: 10% less Gold when buying Wood, Stone or Crystal at this city; selling prices stay unchanged.

fortify.name: Fortification construction
fortify.summary: 10% less Gold to build or upgrade this city’s Fort, Citadel and Castle; material costs and one build per day stay unchanged.

library.name: Library construction
library.summary: 10% less Gold to build or upgrade this city’s spell library; material costs and spell prerequisites stay unchanged.

spellbook.name: Spellbook purchase
spellbook.summary: 25% less Gold for a visiting hero’s spellbook. Learning eligible spells remains free, as in the current game.

recruit.name: Favored recruitment
recruit.summary: 5% less Gold per recruited member of the favored family, both unlocked forms. Other resources, population and access checks stay unchanged.

upgrade.name: Favored troop training
upgrade.summary: 15% less Gold on the normal per-unit upgrade price difference for the favored family in this city. No extra stock is consumed.

equipment.name: Artifact purchases
equipment.summary: 10% less Gold for purchases from this city’s Artifact Merchant or Workshop. Stocks, rarities and other resource costs stay unchanged.

watch.name: Watchtower vision
watch.summary: +2 hexes to this city’s existing vision radius while its Watchtower is built; no hero vision bonus and no fog-map reveal on dedication.

dwelling.name: Favored dwelling construction
dwelling.summary: 10% less Gold to build or upgrade the favored family’s dwelling in this city. No new creature access or covenant is granted.

civic.name: Civic construction
civic.summary: 10% less Gold on this city’s civic-hall upgrades; level prerequisites and construction limits stay unchanged.
